First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a pace, fast. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Goon Ride group ride

One of the hardest and fastest drop rides in the DC area, per DC Paceline. Twice a week from Veirs Mill Park during daylight-savings months. Not a beginner ride. Bring lights and know the route.
